Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the University of Liverpool, England under the direction of Professor G. W. Kenner. After five months I resigned and returned to Greece for family reasons. I worked for a short time in the Department of Biology of the Nuclear Research Center "Demokritos" in Agia Paraskewi-Attiki.

Worked in the condification of chemical information for computer programming at the IDCmbH (Internationale Documentationsgesellschaft fur Chemie) in Frankfurt, Main, West Germany. In October 1972 I was appointed to the position of Lecturer in the Laboratory of Organic Chemistry, Athens, Greece, a position I still hold. I teach organic chemistry to students majoring in Chemistry, Pharmacy, Biology, and Geology. I also supervise the Organic Chemistry Laboratory Exercises of the above students, prepare teaching aids for laboratory exercises and do the written examinations in practical organic chemistry. My research interests are in the area of synthetic organic chemistry, especially peptide chemistry. I am presently concerned with the synthesis of compounds with pharmacological and medicinal interest, e.g. alkylated amino acids, steKodal esters, and amino acid derivative complexes with metals (Pd, Pt, etc.)
